slides.label: Verse 1
lines: Our Lord Jesus Christ
In whom divinity resides
You are the Son of God
The will of the Father made flesh

slides.label: Verse 2
lines: You were born on earth
But your life came from above
You rule through all generations,
An endless era

slides.label: Verse 3
lines: You are God and God alone
None beside You
In this age and in the ages to come

slides.label: Verse 4
lines: No other god has these claims of such powers
In this age and in the ages to come

slides.label: Verse 5
lines: Honour and glory be to You forever
Power and dominion are Yours great God
All wisdom, knowledge, and understanding
Are Yours, holy God, forever more

slides.label: Verse 6
lines: Your word is life
Springing from the wells of eternity
With great splendour and dominion

slides.label: Verse 7
lines: Spreading through everlasting ages

slides.label: Verse 8
lines: With the glory that never fades
Never fades

slides.label: Verse 9
lines: You are the substance and the essence of life

slides.label: Verse 10
lines: Essence of life

slides.label: Verse 11
lines: Your glory is voiced

slides.label: Verse 12
lines: In all languages
and sounds of creation

slides.label: Verse 13
lines: Honour and glory be to You forever
Power and dominion are Yours great God
All wisdom, knowledge, and understanding
Are Yours, holy God, forever more

slides.label: Verse 14
lines: You are so holy
Yes, so holy
With all dominion, You reign forever

slides.label: Verse 15
lines: You are so righteous
Yes, so righteous
With truth and grace, You rule forever

slides.label: Verse 16
lines: Honour and glory be to You forever
Power and dominion are Yours, great God
All wisdom, knowledge, and understanding
Are Yours holy God forever more

slides.label: Verse 17
lines: All wisdom, knowledge, and understanding
Are Yours holy God forever more
